description: Tool-selection evaluation (Phase 5, Milestone 3.6). Fictional demo orders only (data/demo_orders.json, example.com emails). 'expected_tools' is the ideal selection (order ignored); 'acceptable' lists other selections that are also reasonable. 'script' is a scripted model decision fed to the real pipeline through a fake Cohere client, and 'expected_outcome' is what the pipeline must do with it. 'scenario' says whether the scripted decision is the ideal one (faithful) or a deliberately wrong one (misbehaving). The scripts are written by hand: they test orchestration and safety, NOT how well a real model chooses tools.
